_envelope._assertion: Reject — `inbound_webhook_idempotency` UNIQUE on (vendor_id, operator_id, vendor_event_id) prevents shadow-write across vendors. The numeric id 8842301 is identical to a Square `order_id` previously seen for the same operator, but the idempotency key is namespaced by `vendor_id = 'revel'` so the row inserts fresh on Revel's side. Crucially, the canonical fact upsert key is also namespaced — `(vendor_id, operator_id, vendor_entity_id, vendor_modified_at)` — so Revel's row never overwrites Square's row even though the numeric id collides. The fixture documents that the Revel side accepts the write (its own namespace) while ANY attempt to write into a non-Revel namespace using this id MUST be rejected by the namespace UNIQUE.
